title: Retail Discount Strategy Analysis
description: An extensive exploratory data analysis investigating how retail discount strategies influence profitability, identifying loss-making discount thresholds, and deriving statistically validated pricing recommendations.
businessProblem: How do discount levels affect retail profitability, and what pricing strategy maximizes sustainable profit?
workflow: Raw dataset ingestion and quality assessment
Data cleaning and uninformative column pruning
Business feature engineering and metric derivation
Identification of the 20% loss-making discount cliff
Statistical validation using ANOVA, t-tests, and correlation
Executive pricing guardrails and discount governance
results: Discount is the primary driver of profit margin erosion (r = -0.86). Transactions with discounts up to 20% remain profitable, but discounts above 20% produce consistent net losses across all customer segments and regions.
lessonsLearned: Revenue volume can create an illusion of business health ('profitless prosperity'). Calibrating discount thresholds using statistical validation protects unit margins and prevents structural losses.
